name: nexus_get_games
description:
List all Nexus games with domain_name, mod counts, and file counts [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].
Use this to find the correct lowercase domain_name slug for other tools.

Returns:
    JSON array of games: {id, domain_name, name, genre, mods, file_count,
    downloads, approved_date, collections}. With '_rl' rate-limit snapshot.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied client-side to game name/domain_name (reduces output size).
filter.title: Filter

include_unapproved.description: Include games that are not yet fully approved on Nexus.
include_unapproved.title: Include Unapproved
